summary.scopeNote: All six scenarios are a scoped pass for this isolated SDK/manager + real DeepSeek answer synthetic run only. Not overall model-effect layer close and not production acceptance.

scenarios.reason: new-session recall injected fact; model quoted token
scenarios.scoringRule: pass iff recallHit>=1 AND fragmentInRequest AND answer contains FACT token

scenarios.reason: scoped: relevant adopted; unrelated token absent from answer (irrelInRequest=true — NOT a relevance-filter proof)
answerQuotes: The warehouse Alpha shipping address code is SYN-FACT-S2-REL-3460EF9FA-A91C.
scenarios.scoringRule: pass iff relevant fragment in request+answer AND unrelated token NOT in answer

coverageLimit.passMeansEn: answer did not adopt unrelated content

scenarios.reason: scoped: SDK supersedeAtom left only NEW in context; model adopted NEW not OLD (NOT full product conflict-entry flow)
scenarios.scoringRule: pass iff queryAtoms returns only NEW, OLD not retrievable, answer has NEW and not OLD

coverageLimit.passMeansZh: 更新后查询与回答采用新事实
coverageLimit.doesNotProveZh: 产品入口完整冲突处理流程

scenarios.reason: wrong-owner ACL empty context; model did not adopt secret
scenarios.scoringRule: pass iff ACL deny hits=0 AND fragment not in request AND answer lacks SECRET

scenarios.reason: scoped: path1 forgetMemoryEntry removed source; model did not use token (NOT fact-level soft forget / all-sources / post-restart)
scenarios.scoringRule: pass iff pre-forget hit, forgetMemoryEntry deleted, post-forget no FACT in snippets/request/answer
scenarios.nameZh: 遗忘后不用被禁用来源

coverageLimit.doesNotProveEn: fact-level soft forget, all-sources handling, or post-restart forget acceptance

scenarios.reason: candidate excluded from recall/context; model did not adopt; approve control injects
scenarios.scoringRule: pass iff candidate not in recall/request/answer AND approve control makes lesson injectable
